entities.name: Herodorus of Megara
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Herodorus of Megara was a renowned ancient Greek musician and ten-time Olympic victor in the trumpet contest, celebrated for his exceptional size and the loudness of his trumpet (salpinx) playing.

Born in ancient Megara, Greece, Herodorus' remarkable talent and unwavering dedication to his craft earned him widespread recognition and admiration.

As a master of the salpinx, Herodorus' music had a profound impact on the cultural and artistic landscape of ancient Greece, influencing generations of musicians to come.

His legacy extends beyond his own time, with his music and techniques continuing to inspire and influence musicians to this day.

'For the size of one's trumpet is not the measure of one's music, but rather the depth of one's soul.' - Herodorus of Megara
